headline.zh: 滨江绿之丘一层咖啡店
headline.en: Coffee shop on Yangpu Riverside's Lvzhi Hill ground floor

traits.zh: 位于杨浦滨江绿之丘一层，白天可感受鸟语花香，夜晚可欣赏滨江沿线
traits.en: On the ground floor of Yangpu Riverside's Lvzhi Hill: birdsong and flowers by day, riverside views by night

linger.en: Suitable for lingering day or night
